newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez rises ahead of property briefing.
newsitem.headline: Suez rises ahead of property briefing.

text.p: Shares in Compagnie de Suez rose on Monday ahead of a briefing for analysts and journalists on its property holdings, market sources said.
The stock was up 3.78 percent at at 233.50 francs in a volume of 302,005 shares at 1508 GMT.

One analyst said Suez had decided not to sell the whole of its property porftolio estimated at 12 billion francs and was negotiating the disposal of about a third of its real estate assets, worth around 4.5 billion francs.
The company may announce the end of the negotiations, the analyst said.
The market wants to know the loss incurred on the sale, while viewing any reduction to property risk as positive for Suez.
Suez announced last Friday the sale of an office building with 3,600 square metres space at the La Defense business complex on the Paris outskirts. It gave no price details.
